display.name: MongoDB Search
mongot pods up
display.description: mongot pods that Prometheus scrapes successfully.

display.name: Envoy pods up
display.description: Envoy pods that Prometheus scrapes successfully.

display.name: mongot pods in Envoy
display.description: The smallest number of healthy mongot pods any Envoy pod sees. Below the number of mongot pods, an Envoy pod has lost one.

display.name: Searches per second
display.description: Text and vector searches, all mongot pods, 5 minute rate.

display.name: Largest share on one pod
display.description: The share of all searches that the busiest mongot pod served. With three pods and even balancing this is about 33%. Near 100% means one pod serves everything while the others stay Ready: the failure that produces no error. 0% when no search ran in the last 5 minutes.

display.name: Searches per second, per mongot pod
display.description: Envoy picks a mongot pod per request, so the lines should sit together.

display.name: Share of searches, per mongot pod
display.description: Each pod's part of all searches.

display.name: Requests per second to mongot, per Envoy pod
display.description: One Envoy pod at zero is normal with one mongod connection: the Route places connections, not requests.

spec.query: (sum by (pod) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_cluster_name="mongot_rs_cluster"}[5m]))) and on (pod) topk(1, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"}))

(sum by (pod) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_cluster_name="mongot_rs_cluster"}[5m]))) and on (pod) (topk(2, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})) unless topk(1, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})))

(sum by (pod) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_cluster_name="mongot_rs_cluster"}[5m]))) and on (pod) (topk(3, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})) unless topk(2, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})))

(sum by (pod) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_cluster_name="mongot_rs_cluster"}[5m]))) unless on (pod) topk(3, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"}))

display.name: Open connections from mongod, per Envoy pod
display.description: Where the Route's balance algorithm put each connection.

spec.query: (sum by (pod) (envoy_listener_downstream_cx_active{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_listener_address="0.0.0.0_27028"})) and on (pod) topk(1, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"}))

(sum by (pod) (envoy_listener_downstream_cx_active{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_listener_address="0.0.0.0_27028"})) and on (pod) (topk(2, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})) unless topk(1, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})))

(sum by (pod) (envoy_listener_downstream_cx_active{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_listener_address="0.0.0.0_27028"})) and on (pod) (topk(3, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})) unless topk(2, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})))

(sum by (pod) (envoy_listener_downstream_cx_active{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_listener_address="0.0.0.0_27028"})) unless on (pod) topk(3, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"}))

display.name: Retries per second, per Envoy pod
display.description: Envoy retries onto another mongot pod when one sheds load or resets a stream. Sustained retries mean mongot is undersized.

spec.query: (sum by (pod) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_retry_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_cluster_name="mongot_rs_cluster"}[5m]))) and on (pod) topk(1, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"}))

(sum by (pod) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_retry_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_cluster_name="mongot_rs_cluster"}[5m]))) and on (pod) (topk(2, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})) unless topk(1, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})))

(sum by (pod) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_retry_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_cluster_name="mongot_rs_cluster"}[5m]))) and on (pod) (topk(3, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})) unless topk(2, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})))

(sum by (pod) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_retry_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_cluster_name="mongot_rs_cluster"}[5m]))) unless on (pod) topk(3, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"}))

display.name: Responses per second from mongot, by class
display.description: 2xx is success. gRPC errors still answer 200; see the search failures panel.

display.name: Envoy to mongot latency, 95th percentile
display.description: Time Envoy waited for mongot, across both Envoy pods.

display.name: Average search latency, per mongot pod
display.description: Text searches only. No line while a pod serves none.

display.name: Search failures per second, per mongot pod
display.description: Text and vector searches that mongot failed.

display.name: Replication lag, per mongot pod
display.description: How far the pod's most delayed index is behind the source replica set.

display.name: JVM memory used, per mongot pod
display.description: Heap and non-heap together.

display.name: CPU used, per mongot pod
display.description: mongot's own CPU use, averaged over 5 minutes, as a share of the CPUs the process sees (mongot_system_cpu_count; with a CPU limit of 1 that is one core).

display.name: JVM heap used, percent of limit, per mongot pod
display.description: Heap in use against the heap's maximum. The panel above shows heap and non-heap together, in bytes.

display.name: Time in garbage collection, per mongot pod
display.description: Share of time the JVM spent paused for garbage collection, 5 minute rate.

display.name: Uptime, per mongot pod
display.description: Time since the mongot process started. A fall to zero is a restart.

display.name: Search work run outside the parallel pool, per mongot pod
display.description: Tasks per second that found mongot's concurrent search or vector rescoring pool full and ran on the calling thread instead. The search is still answered; above zero, the pool is saturated.

display.name: Index size, per mongot pod
display.description: Bytes of all search and vector indexes on the pod. Every pod holds every index, so the lines should sit close together; each pod merges its own segments, so they need not be equal.

display.name: Documents indexed, per mongot pod
display.description: Documents in all indexes on the pod. Equal on every pod once each has caught up with mongod.

display.name: Indexes not STEADY, per mongot pod
display.description: Indexes whose state is anything but STEADY: INITIAL_SYNC, STALE, FAILED, RECOVERING and the rest. Should be 0; above it, that pod's copy of an index is not ready.

display.name: Indexes in catalog, per mongot pod
display.description: How many indexes each pod knows about. The same on every pod.

display.name: Data volume used, per mongot pod
display.description: Used share of the file system under mongot's data path, as mongot reports it. With a volume of its own per pod this is that volume; with a hostpath provisioner it is the node's disk, the same on every pod.

display.name: Indexing operations per second, per mongot pod
display.description: Inserts, updates and deletes applied to the indexes, 5 minute rate. Every pod applies the same changes, so the lines should move together.

display.title: Is traffic spread across the mongot pods?
